The film stars Robert De Niro and Eddie Murphy in the lead roles alongside Rene Russo, William Shatner, Pedro Damian and De Niro's real life adopted daughter Drena De Niro.  The film was released in the United States on March 15, 2002.
Charles R. Rogers filmography | Charles R. Rogers, also known as Chas.  R. Rogers, was an American film producer whose career lasted from 1924 through 1957.  Through most of his career he operated as an independent film producer, although he did have stints at both RKO and Universal, including head of production at UA.
